resources.string: Paste a link or search the web
When a video link is shared

Paste a link from TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Vimeo… or type words to search the web for videos.

On any web page tap “Download video” to save the videos found on it.

Tip: in any app tap Share → VidSaver.
Search for a song or artist on SoundCloud.\nResults download as MP3.
No videos yet.\nDownloaded videos appear here.
No music yet.\nDownload a song as MP3 and it appears here.
No files yet.\nPDFs, APKs, ZIPs and other files appear here.

1. Copy or share a link from TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Vimeo or any website → Share → VidSaver.

2. Or paste a link in the Download tab and tap Go.

3. Search and More open web pages inside VidSaver. Play the video, then tap the orange “Download video (N)” button and choose a quality — or “Detect automatically”.

4. Music searches SoundCloud; tap MP3 to save a song.

5. “Download later” saves data: start tonight in your night bundle hours, at a time you pick, or when on Wi-Fi. See the Queue to change the order.

6. Finished downloads are in the Play tab and in your phone's Download/VidSaver folder.

YouTube is not supported.

Please download only content you own or have permission to download.
